[quote=norrhollow;58516754][b]The White Sea Caucus[/b]

Minister Ostman, together with the members of the hawkish "White Sea Caucus" of the House Radicals, would enact a six-point response to Queen Mij Drs's offers of diplomatic dialogue, once again reiterating that the island of Austmark now constitutes, together with its exclusive economic zone, the newest territorial extent of both the State of Norrhollow and the Commonwealth of High Albany. In a session before the House Committee on Foreign Affairs, Ostman and other key Radical allies reiterate its previous points without showing any evidence of compromise:

[list][b]Ostman's Six Points[/b]

[*]The island of Austmark is a fundamental territory of the Commonwealth of High Albany.

[*]Austmark's occupation and annexation were done in accordance with democratic instruments.

[*]Austmark's occupation and annexation did not impede the life, liberty, or property of any living persons, Thrømm or Albic, and were undertaken with the highest consideration for potential ecological impacts.

[*]Speculation as to Austmark's role as a forward operating base (FOB) designed to target the sovereignty of the Thýven is baseless and steeped in anti-Albic xenophobia.

[*]As evidenced by internal investigations, the Thrømm maintain no basis for laying claim to Austmark, nor did later field work by Albic officers reveal any evidence of Thrømm settlements in the area, whether in the form of documents or archaelogical evidence.

[*]Thýven is the sole originator of political tensions concerning Austmark Island, which High Albany is merely striving to defend.

[/list]

The six points would be physically delivered to the Albic embassy in Tharkønn by the Albic ambassador to Thýven, David Aakjaer, stamped with the seal of the Commonwealth. Another document attached would include a list of Albic dignitaries that have supported the six points, the chief of which would be Minister Ostman. Other notable signatures would include centrist Moderates like Governor Eske Fjällstra of Norrhollow and Lieutenant Governor Honor Almstedt, as well as all representatives under the White Sea Caucus.

Opposition to the White Sea Caucus would manifest chiefly in the form of the dovish factions of the Radical Party and some isolationist elements within the Moderate Party, both of whom would criticize Minister Ostman's actions as extend beyond her executive mandate. Though, with public opinion strongly in favor of the White Sea Caucus, these pro-compromise politicians would remain silent for now, waiting patiently for Thýven's response to the six points.[/quote]
[b]250th Convention of the Estates General[/b]

Following the reception of the six points, Queen Mij would order a joint session of all three branches of the government to convene in order to draft a formal and acceptable response, lauding the rapidity with which the government of Thýven was dealing with the matter.

The government of Thýven would formally accept the six points, sending a signatory document to the Albic states relating to the Island and its future non-contestation by the government of Thýven, present or future. The matter had ruffled many of the more aggressive statesmen within the Gøsfoddel, who claimed that Thýven with its longstanding presence in the White Sea had a full right to all islands in that part of the seal, however, these were labelled reactionary and shunted out of parliament within a day of the agreement being sent to Albic states. 

In a speech by queen Mij later that afternoon she would state.

"It is only right that the ever civil state of Thýven, who has watched with peaceful, but careful, eye over the waters which pass by its lands should seek to ensure the security of the lands therein. However, it is necessary that our southern neighbours recieve also their due rights to the waters, the era of the one species one nation ideology is long over....we are in the future now...there is no place for blatant Imperialism on our part by our state."

With the tensions between Hydronias ally, Thýven and High Albany beginning to fade, Hydronia has reduced its recent militarisation. The 7th fleet has been recalled and replaced by the smaller 13th fleet, who are not permitted to completely destroy unauthorised vessels. 3/6 of the missile launchers put on standby have been disarmed, but 3 still remain on standby and anti-missile/anti-aircraft systems remain operational.
